subtitle: Health & more to your server
promotionalText: Keep your Health records, contacts, calendars and places in your own substrate.
description:
Substrate Sync sends what you choose from this device to your substrate, the personal server you run or choose: Apple Health records, contacts, calendars, reminders, and the places you stayed at. Nothing is written back to your device.

• Choose each source, and what of it to send
• Syncs in the background, on the schedule you pick
• Send to Substrate: save what any app shares, from the share sheet
• Shows what was sent, and what is waiting

Your data goes only to your substrate. If you turn on Places, Apple Maps receives the coordinates of the places you stayed at, to name them. Health data is never used for advertising. Substrate Sync is a client for a substrate: sign in with your server's address and approve what the app may do there.
